profiles.name: Mayank Nigam
profiles.head: Client Partner, Aspire Systems (UK & EU new business)
strengths: Works as a client partner bringing in new business: generates leads, closes deals and runs accounts in Benelux and the Nordics
Has exceeded revenue targets on several contracts; worked as client partner at Flutura before
gaps: Current city is not shown and he may be based in Europe now
Sells to Europe, not the US, and his total years may be at the low end
profiles.next: Confirm he is based in India. Ask how many of his EU deals were new logos versus growing existing accounts.

profiles.name: Arjun A S
profiles.head: Senior Account Executive, Happiest Minds (ex-Client Partner, Aspire Systems)
strengths: Has been a client partner at two digital services firms (Aspire, then Happiest Minds)
Based in Bengaluru, so no relocation
gaps: Profile has little detail: no deal sizes or territory
No sign of testing (QE) or GCC sales
profiles.next: Phone screen: his territory, how many new logos he wins a year, and whether he has sold testing services

profiles.name: Nilesh Bhammar
profiles.head: Senior Strategic Account Manager, Sonata Software
strengths: Has a mandate to win new logos and has re-activated dormant accounts
Hit 165% of target at his previous company
gaps: Sells software licences and cloud resale (Microsoft, Oracle, AWS), not engineering services
Sells only to Indian enterprises; no global or GCC selling
profiles.next: Only worth pursuing if IGS will consider someone moving from licence resale to services sales

profiles.name: Mahesh Ashture
profiles.head: Enterprise Sales Manager, Sonata Software
strengths: Sells cloud migration and Azure/AWS to CXOs in BFSI and manufacturing companies
Has stayed 19 years with one employer
gaps: Sells cloud resale and SaaS, not engineering or testing services
profiles.next: Low priority; keep him as a source of Pune referrals
